NCTB living/photo sets replaced: bird->books, deer-eyes->mangoes, dolls->spinning tops, seven martyr photos->seven stars, planets->balls, dragonflies->lemons. ৬ seasons is an objects-only nature montage (any human silhouette removed); ৯ is a clock (object). image_slots.prompt: A clean children's-textbook counting page for numbers 1 to 10, each numeral beside a clearly countable set of simple objects: 1 book, 2 mangoes, 3 pens, 4 eggs (one 'hali'), 5 spinning tops, a small six-panel montage of the six seasons (landscapes only), 7 stars, 8 balls, a wall clock showing nine o'clock, 10 lemons. Bold flat colour, clear outlines, plain white background, each set easy to count. No people, no animals, no birds, no photographs. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.
